1.title: Did USA team fall short in World Cup? Here's what pundits think
1.summary: After weeks of excitement ended with a defeat to Belgium, Americans have a sense of gratitude but also a missed opportunity.

2.title: Trump’s Tenuous Relationship With NATO Allies
2.summary: At this year’s NATO summit in Turkey, President Trump is arriving with his own priorities — and, as Tyler Pager, The Times’s White House correspondent, explains, they do not necessarily align with those of other NATO leaders.

3.title: Trump Expected to Tell Turkey He Is Ready to Restore Access to F-35 Jets
3.summary: The president, who is headed to a NATO summit in Ankara this week, had imposed the ban himself amid concerns that giving Turkey the jets could allow Russia to learn about their stealth technology.

4.title: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine
4.summary: Police had been hunting Anastasiia Berezovska after a Ukrainian millionaire was injured in the blast.

5.title: Explosions injure 18 in Damascus during Macron's visit
5.summary: As reports of the blasts came in, state television said the Syrian president had welcomed Macron at the presidential palace.

6.title: Zimbabwean football star survives gun attack in South Africa
6.summary: South African police say they are investigating a case of attempted murder but that no arrests have been made so far.
